title: Remote daemon
summary: Saba-chan on other PCs, in this app
steps: To let another PC manage this one, turn on Allow remote connections on this PC and save.
Your PCs linked to the same Discord account appear here. Press Connect on a PC that allows remote connections to pair it, then Open to manage its servers from this app.
For a Linux server you can reach over SSH, use Install on Linux to install Saba-chan and pair it right away.
